desc: Implement input parsing and the `O(1)` feasibility predicate; print `No` exactly when the predicate fails.
Write helpers for edge checks: red edge iff `abs(dr)+abs(dc)==1`, blue edge iff `abs(dr)==abs(dc)==1`, plus a final validator for distinct squares and cyclic adjacency.
Create base-gadget generators for `(2,0)` adjacent red pair, `(0,2)` diagonal blue pair, and `(2,1)` triangle.
Implement constructions: red-only rectangle perimeter, blue-only transformed-grid rectangle perimeter, and mixed red-snake + blue-chain in transformed coordinates with safe shift.
Assemble each case, emit `Yes` and ordered `p r c` lines with buffered I/O.
Verify small cases by hand against the predicate and check coordinate bounds/linearity for total `R+B = 2e5`.
